title: Verify: History loading, ready and error status unit tests
summary: Unit tests for the HistoryStatus rendering
description: Test loading, ready and error rendering with listMine mocked.

steps.action: Create the file mocking ../src/api/client (keep ApiError, MAX_PER_PLAYER, MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH real via importOriginal, mock listMine and submitContribution), mirroring the setup in tests/contributionLoadingLabel.test.tsx. Add test 'shows loading while listMine is pending' (never-resolving promise, expect text 'Loading your suggestions…'), 'hides loading and lists entries on success' (listMine resolves one contribution, expect prompt text and no loading text), and 'shows error alert when listMine rejects' (expect role alert 'Could not load your suggestions'). Contribution shape comes from the Contribution interface in src/api/client.ts.
